WITH prepared_loot_drops AS (
    -- Scope the loot_drops rows
    SELECT
        id,
        match_round_ref,
        guild_rank,
        platform_code,
        released_date,
        DATE_FORMAT(released_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS released_date_label,
        CASE WHEN xp_points >= 35893 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN xp_points >= 9677 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS xp_points_tier
    FROM loot_drops
    WHERE (platform_code = 'XB' OR guild_rank IN ('leader', 'officer'))
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per loot_drop
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.match_round_ref,
        s.guild_rank,
        s.released_date_label,
        s.xp_points_tier,
        l.id AS loot_drop_id,
        l.released_date AS loot_drop_released_date,
        l.guild_rank AS loot_drop_guild_rank,
        l.flag_is_banned AS loot_drop_flag_is_banned
    FROM prepared_loot_drops s
    LEFT JOIN loot_drops l ON l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach loot_drops metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT SUM(l.xp_points) FROM loot_drops l WHERE l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref) AS total_loot_drop_xp_points,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN l.guild_rank IN ('member', 'officer') THEN 1 END) FROM loot_drops l WHERE l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref) AS loot_drop_guild_rank_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loot_drops l WHERE l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref) AS loot_drop_count
    FROM with_children s
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(total_loot_drop_xp_points) OVER (PARTITION BY loot_drop_guild_rank_count ORDER BY loot_drop_count ASC, id, loot_drop_id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4,
        loot_drop_count - LAG(loot_drop_count) OVER (PARTITION BY loot_drop_guild_rank_count ORDER BY loot_drop_released_date DESC, id, loot_drop_id) AS loot_drop_count_change,
        MIN(loot_drop_count) OVER (PARTITION BY loot_drop_id, guild_rank) AS loot_drop_id_guild_rank_min_loot_drop_count
    FROM summarized_rows
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching loot_drops
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM loot_drops l
            WHERE l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref
              AND l.platform_code = 'MOB'
        )
),
detail_rows_loot_drops AS (
    -- One row per loot_drop
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.match_round_ref,
        s.guild_rank,
        s.xp_points_tier,
        s.loot_drop_id,
        s.loot_drop_released_date,
        s.loot_drop_guild_rank,
        s.loot_drop_flag_is_banned,
        s.total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4,
        l.id AS loot_drop_id_2,
        l.flag_is_banned AS loot_drop_flag_is_banned_2,
        l.xp_points AS loot_drop_xp_points,
        l.released_date AS loot_drop_released_date_2
    FROM screened s
    LEFT JOIN loot_drops l ON l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref
),
exploded_detail_loot_drops AS (
    -- One row per loot_drop
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.match_round_ref,
        s.xp_points_tier,
        s.loot_drop_id,
        s.loot_drop_released_date,
        s.loot_drop_guild_rank,
        s.total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4,
        s.loot_drop_id_2,
        l.id AS loot_drop_id_3,
        l.xp_points AS loot_drop_xp_points_2,
        l.platform_code AS loot_drop_platform_code,
        l.flag_is_banned AS loot_drop_flag_is_banned_3,
        l.guild_rank AS loot_drop_guild_rank_2
    FROM detail_rows_loot_drops s
    LEFT JOIN loot_drops l ON l.match_round_ref = s.match_round_ref AND l.flag_is_banned = FALSE
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    match_round_ref,
    xp_points_tier,
    loot_drop_guild_rank,
    total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4,
    loot_drop_platform_code,
    loot_drop_flag_is_banned_3,
    CASE WHEN loot_drop_xp_points_2 >= 25301 THEN 'A' WHEN loot_drop_xp_points_2 >= 10248 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS loot_drop_xp_points_2_tier
FROM exploded_detail_loot_drops
WHERE total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4 <= 180000.0
ORDER BY match_round_ref, id NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_loot_drops = (
    df_loot_drops
    .filter((F.col("platform_code") == "XB") | (F.col("guild_rank").isin("leader", "officer")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "match_round_ref",
        "guild_rank",
        "platform_code",
        "released_date",
        F.date_format(F.col("released_date"), "yyyy-MM").alias("released_date_label"),
        F.when(F.col("xp_points") >= 35893, "HIGH").when(F.col("xp_points") >= 9677, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("xp_points_tier"),
    )
)

with_children = (
    prepared_loot_drops.alias("s")
    .join(df_loot_drops.alias("l"), F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.match_round_ref"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.match_round_ref",
        "s.guild_rank",
        "s.released_date_label",
        "s.xp_points_tier",
        F.col("l.id").alias("loot_drop_id"),
        F.col("l.released_date").alias("loot_drop_released_date"),
        F.col("l.guild_rank").alias("loot_drop_guild_rank"),
        F.col("l.flag_is_banned").alias("loot_drop_flag_is_banned"),
    )
)

loot_drop_stats = (
    df_loot_drops
    .groupBy("match_round_ref")
    .agg(
        F.sum("xp_points").alias("total_loot_drop_xp_points"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("guild_rank").isin("member", "officer"), 1)).alias("loot_drop_guild_rank_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("loot_drop_count"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    with_children.alias("s")
    .join(loot_drop_stats.alias("l"), F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.match_round_ref"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "l.total_loot_drop_xp_points",
        F.coalesce(F.col("l.loot_drop_guild_rank_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("loot_drop_guild_rank_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("l.loot_drop_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("loot_drop_count"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("total_loot_drop_xp_points").over(Window.partitionBy("loot_drop_guild_rank_count").orderBy("loot_drop_count", "id", "loot_drop_id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4"),
        (F.col("loot_drop_count") - F.lag("loot_drop_count").over(Window.partitionBy("loot_drop_guild_rank_count").orderBy(F.col("loot_drop_released_date").desc(), "id", "loot_drop_id"))).alias("loot_drop_count_change"),
        F.min("loot_drop_count").over(Window.partitionBy("loot_drop_id", "guild_rank")).alias("loot_drop_id_guild_rank_min_loot_drop_count"),
    )
)

screened = (
    metrics.alias("s")
    .join(df_loot_drops.alias("l"), (F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.match_round_ref")) & (F.col("l.platform_code") == "MOB"), "left_anti")
)

detail_rows_loot_drops = (
    screened.alias("s")
    .join(df_loot_drops.alias("l"), F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.match_round_ref"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.match_round_ref",
        "s.guild_rank",
        "s.xp_points_tier",
        "s.loot_drop_id",
        "s.loot_drop_released_date",
        "s.loot_drop_guild_rank",
        "s.loot_drop_flag_is_banned",
        "s.total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4",
        F.col("l.id").alias("loot_drop_id_2"),
        F.col("l.flag_is_banned").alias("loot_drop_flag_is_banned_2"),
        F.col("l.xp_points").alias("loot_drop_xp_points"),
        F.col("l.released_date").alias("loot_drop_released_date_2"),
    )
)

exploded_detail_loot_drops = (
    detail_rows_loot_drops.alias("s")
    .join(df_loot_drops.alias("l"), (F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.match_round_ref")) & (~F.col("l.flag_is_banned")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.match_round_ref",
        "s.xp_points_tier",
        "s.loot_drop_id",
        "s.loot_drop_released_date",
        "s.loot_drop_guild_rank",
        "s.total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4",
        "s.loot_drop_id_2",
        F.col("l.id").alias("loot_drop_id_3"),
        F.col("l.xp_points").alias("loot_drop_xp_points_2"),
        F.col("l.platform_code").alias("loot_drop_platform_code"),
        F.col("l.flag_is_banned").alias("loot_drop_flag_is_banned_3"),
        F.col("l.guild_rank").alias("loot_drop_guild_rank_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    exploded_detail_loot_drops
    .filter(F.col("total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4") <= 180000.0)
    .select(
        "id",
        "match_round_ref",
        "xp_points_tier",
        "loot_drop_guild_rank",
        "total_loot_drop_xp_points_avg_4",
        "loot_drop_platform_code",
        "loot_drop_flag_is_banned_3",
        F.when(F.col("loot_drop_xp_points_2") >= 25301, "A").when(F.col("loot_drop_xp_points_2") >= 10248, "B").otherwise("C").alias("loot_drop_xp_points_2_tier"),
    )
    .orderBy("match_round_ref", F.col("id").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        shopper_account_id,
        store_tier,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        ROUND(basket_total * 0.9, 2) AS basket_total_adj
    FROM baskets
    WHERE line_net < 725.4
      AND line_qty >= 3
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(basket_total_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY store_tier, line_qty) AS store_tier_line_qty_max_basket_total_adj,
        line_net - LAG(line_net) OVER (PARTITION BY shopper_account_id, line_qty ORDER BY line_qty, id) AS line_net_change
    FROM scoped
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per store_tier, shopper_account_id
    SELECT
        id,
        shopper_account_id,
        store_tier,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        basket_total_adj,
        store_tier_line_qty_max_basket_total_adj,
        line_net_change
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_tier, shopper_account_id ORDER BY basket_total_adj DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per store_tier
    SELECT
        id,
        shopper_account_id,
        store_tier,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        basket_total_adj,
        store_tier_line_qty_max_basket_total_adj,
        line_net_change
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_tier ORDER BY line_net_change DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM latest
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
unique_rows_2 AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per store_tier, shopper_account_id
    SELECT
        id,
        shopper_account_id,
        store_tier,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        basket_total_adj,
        store_tier_line_qty_max_basket_total_adj,
        line_net_change
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_tier, shopper_account_id ORDER BY line_net DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM unique_rows
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
latest_2 AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per shopper_account_id
    SELECT
        id,
        shopper_account_id,
        store_tier,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        basket_total_adj,
        store_tier_line_qty_max_basket_total_adj,
        line_net_change
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY shopper_account_id ORDER BY basket_total_adj DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM unique_rows_2
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    shopper_account_id,
    store_tier,
    line_qty,
    line_net,
    basket_total_adj,
    store_tier_line_qty_max_basket_total_adj,
    LENGTH(TRIM(store_tier)) AS store_tier_len
FROM latest_2
ORDER BY store_tier DESC NULLS FIRST

unique_rows = (

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the broadcasts rows
    SELECT
        id,
        channels_tv_id,
        rating_pts,
        spot_aired_ts,
        audience_tags,
        CONCAT_WS('-', spot_type, program_title) AS spot_type_program_title_label,
        ABS(share_percent - 34.0) AS share_percent_distance
    FROM broadcasts
    WHERE (channels_tv_id <= 13 OR spot_type IN ('psa', 'promo'))
),
broadcast_stats AS (
    -- Per-channels_tv broadcasts metrics
    SELECT channels_tv_id, COUNT(*) AS broadcast_count
    FROM broadcasts
    GROUP BY channels_tv_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach broadcasts metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(b.broadcast_count, 0) AS broadcast_count
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN broadcast_stats b ON b.channels_tv_id = s.channels_tv_id
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        channels_tv_id,
        SUM(broadcast_count) AS total_broadcast_count,
        SUM(rating_pts) AS total_rating_pts,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM profiled
    WHERE channels_tv_id >= 29
    GROUP BY channels_tv_id
    HAVING SUM(share_percent_distance) > 15.0
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach broadcasts metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN b.daypart IN ('prime', 'late') THEN 1 END) FROM broadcasts b WHERE b.channels_tv_id = s.channels_tv_id) AS broadcast_daypart_count
    FROM rollup_base s
),
with_details_channels_tv AS (
    -- Join channels_tv
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.program_title AS channels_tv_program_title,
        c.share_pct AS channels_tv_share_pct
    FROM with_counts s
    JOIN channels_tv c ON c.id = s.channels_tv_id
),
joined_channels_tv AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.share_pct AS channels_tv_share_pct_2,
        c.panel_region AS channels_tv_panel_region,
        c.program_title AS channels_tv_program_title_2
    FROM with_details_channels_tv s
    JOIN channels_tv c ON c.id = s.channels_tv_id
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        channels_tv_id,
        total_broadcast_count,
        broadcast_daypart_count,
        channels_tv_program_title_2,
        COALESCE(channels_tv_panel_region, 'UNKNOWN') AS channels_tv_panel_region_or_unknown,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(channels_tv_panel_region), 1, 3) AS channels_tv_panel_region_prefix,
        ROUND(total_rating_pts / NULLIF(n_rows, 0), 3) AS total_rating_pts_per_n_rows
    FROM joined_channels_tv
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching broadcasts
    SELECT s.*
    FROM derived s
    WHERE s.channels_tv_id IN (
            SELECT b.channels_tv_id
            FROM broadcasts b
            WHERE b.rating_pts >= 6.9
              AND b.spot_aired_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-13 13:00:00'
        )
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(total_broadcast_count / NULLIF(broadcast_daypart_count, 0), 3) AS total_broadcast_count_per_broadcast_daypart_coun
    FROM without_matches
)
SELECT
    channels_tv_id,
    total_broadcast_count,
    broadcast_daypart_count,
    channels_tv_program_title_2,
    channels_tv_panel_region_or_unknown,
    total_rating_pts_per_n_rows,
    total_broadcast_count_per_broadcast_daypart_coun
FROM labeled
WHERE total_rating_pts_per_n_rows <= 9.0
ORDER BY total_broadcast_count_per_broadcast_daypart_coun DESC, total_rating_pts_per_n_rows DESC, channels_tv_id
LIMIT 5

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped = (
    df_broadcasts
    .filter((F.col("channels_tv_id") <= 13) | (F.col("spot_type").isin("psa", "promo")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channels_tv_id",
        "rating_pts",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "audience_tags",
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("spot_type"), F.col("program_title")).alias("spot_type_program_title_label"),
        F.abs(F.col("share_percent") - 34.0).alias("share_percent_distance"),
    )
)

broadcast_stats = (
    df_broadcasts
    .groupBy("channels_tv_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("broadcast_count"))
)

profiled = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(broadcast_stats.alias("b"), F.col("b.channels_tv_id") == F.col("s.channels_tv_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.broadcast_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("broadcast_count"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    profiled
    .filter(F.col("channels_tv_id") >= 29)
    .groupBy("channels_tv_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("broadcast_count").alias("total_broadcast_count"),
        F.sum("rating_pts").alias("total_rating_pts"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.sum("share_percent_distance").alias("sum_share_percent_distance_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_share_percent_distance_check") > 15.0)
    .drop("sum_share_percent_distance_check")
)

broadcast_stats_2 = (
    df_broadcasts
    .groupBy("channels_tv_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("daypart").isin("prime", "late"), 1)).alias("broadcast_daypart_count"),
    )
)

with_counts = (
    rollup_base.alias("s")
    .join(broadcast_stats_2.alias("b"), F.col("b.channels_tv_id") == F.col("s.channels_tv_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.broadcast_daypart_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("broadcast_daypart_count"),
    )
)

with_details_channels_tv = (
    with_counts.alias("s")
    .join(df_channels_tv.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.channels_tv_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.program_title").alias("channels_tv_program_title"),
        F.col("c.share_pct").alias("channels_tv_share_pct"),
    )
)

joined_channels_tv = (
    with_details_channels_tv.alias("s")
    .join(df_channels_tv.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.channels_tv_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.share_pct").alias("channels_tv_share_pct_2"),
        F.col("c.panel_region").alias("channels_tv_panel_region"),
        F.col("c.program_title").alias("channels_tv_program_title_2"),
    )
)

derived = (
    joined_channels_tv
    .select(
        "channels_tv_id",
        "total_broadcast_count",
        "broadcast_daypart_count",
        "channels_tv_program_title_2",
        F.coalesce(F.col("channels_tv_panel_region"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channels_tv_panel_region_or_unknown"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("channels_tv_panel_region")), 1, 3).alias("channels_tv_panel_region_prefix"),
        F.round(F.col("total_rating_pts") / F.nullif(F.col("n_rows"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("total_rating_pts_per_n_rows"),
    )
)

        s.vessel_flag_clean,
        v.built_on AS voyage_built_on,
        v.vessel_flag AS voyage_vessel_flag
    FROM recent s
    JOIN voyages v ON v.id = s.voyage_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        vessel_flag,
        least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity,
        vessel_flag_clean,
        voyage_built_on,
        voyage_vessel_flag,
        LAST_VALUE(arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_vessel_flag, MONTH(voyage_built_on) ORDER BY least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_arrived_on,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(voyage_built_on), MONTH(arrived_on) ORDER BY voyage_built_on, id), 3) AS voyage_built_on_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_id ORDER BY arrived_on), 3) AS arrived_on_cume_dist,
        LEAD(voyage_built_on) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_vessel_flag, MONTH(voyage_built_on) ORDER BY least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity ASC, id) AS next_voyage_built_on,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_id ORDER BY arrived_on, id) AS arrived_on_seq,
        LEAD(voyage_built_on, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(voyage_built_on), MONTH(arrived_on) ORDER BY voyage_built_on, id) AS next3_voyage_built_on,
        LEAD(voyage_built_on) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_id ORDER BY arrived_on, id) AS next_voyage_built_on_2,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(voyage_built_on), MONTH(arrived_on) ORDER BY voyage_built_on), 3) AS voyage_built_on_percent_rank_2,
        FIRST_VALUE(arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_id ORDER BY arrived_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_arrived_on,
        NTH_VALUE(voyage_built_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_vessel_flag, MONTH(voyage_built_on) ORDER BY least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_voyage_built_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(voyage_built_on) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_id, vessel_flag ORDER BY arrived_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_voyage_built_on,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_vessel_flag, MONTH(voyage_built_on) ORDER BY least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity ASC) AS least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity_dense_rank,
        DATEDIFF(arrived_on, LAG(arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY voyage_vessel_flag, MONTH(voyage_built_on) ORDER BY least_reefer_temp_teu_capacity ASC, id)) AS days_since_prev_arrived_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(voyage_built_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(voyage_built_on), MONTH(arrived_on) ORDER BY voyage_built_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_voyage_built_on
    FROM joined
),
per_group AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', first_known_voyage_built_on) AS first_known_voyage_built_on_month,
        ROUND(SUM(voyage_built_on_percent_rank), 2) AS total_voyage_built_on_percent_rank,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(voyage_vessel_flag)) AS voyage_vessel_flag_list
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', first_known_voyage_built_on)
    HAVING MAX(arrived_on_cume_dist) > 0.3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    first_known_voyage_built_on_month,
    total_voyage_built_on_percent_rank,

outliers AS (

    FROM base_gates s

gate_stats AS (

profiled AS (

    FROM outliers s

summary AS (

    FROM fact_reviews
    WHERE storefront_id IS NOT NULL
      AND basket_total < 1816.2
),
joined_storefront AS (
    -- Join storefronts
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.storefront_id,
        s.basket_state,
        s.account_opened_on,
        s.account_opened_on_quarter,
        st.shopper_handle AS storefront_shopper_handle,
        st.basket_state AS storefront_basket_state,
        st.voucher_amt AS storefront_voucher_amt
    FROM base s
    JOIN storefronts st ON st.id = s.storefront_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY basket_state, storefront_basket_state ORDER BY account_opened_on DESC, id), 3) AS account_opened_on_cume_dist,
        ROUND(storefront_voucher_amt - AVG(storefront_voucher_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', account_opened_on)), 2) AS storefront_voucher_amt_vs_account_opened_on_mont,
        MIN(storefront_voucher_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', account_opened_on)) AS account_opened_on_month_min_storefront_voucher_a,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(storefront_id) OVER w_account_opened_on_month) AS distinct_storefront_id_in_account_opened_on_mont,
        SUM(storefront_voucher_amt) OVER w_account_opened_on_month AS account_opened_on_month_sum_storefront_voucher_a,
        FIRST_VALUE(account_opened_on_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY basket_state, storefront_basket_state ORDER BY account_opened_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_account_opened_on_quarter
    FROM joined_storefront
    WINDOW w_account_opened_on_month AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', account_opened_on))
),
annotated AS (

        *,
        ROUND(storefront_voucher_amt * 0.9, 2) AS storefront_voucher_amt_adj,
        UPPER(TRIM(storefront_basket_state)) AS storefront_basket_state_clean
    FROM metrics

        ROUND(AVG(xp_points) OVER w_platform_cd, 2) AS platform_cd_avg_xp_points
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_platform_cd AS (PARTITION BY platform_cd)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,

        MIN(first_ping_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY platform_cd, ping_ms_tier) AS platform_cd_ping_ms_tier_min_first_ping_ms,
        LAG(xp_points, 3, 0) OVER w_player_profile_id_by_xp_poin_3 AS prev3_xp_points
    FROM sequenced

)
